digest.component_or_area: Jira Reconciler three-way merge baseline advance
propositions: The reconciler baseline is advanced from a pre-outbound snapshot, leaving it one pass behind after the reconciler itself pushes a field to Jira, causing the guard `local == baseline` to fire falsely on the next pass.

A local status change (reopen/un-claim) is silently reverted by inbound mirroring when the new local value equals the stale baseline, even though other fields written in the same pass survive because they differ from the baseline.

The baseline must be overlaid with confirmed per-mutation pushes immediately after outbound apply succeeds, keyed on per-mutation success not pass exit code, to prevent false sync claims from soft-failed transitions.

The ABA defect (baseline B → pushed A → local reverted to B) affects all five inbound-mirrored fields (summary, description, priority, status, assignee) that share the `_suppressed_by_inbound` guard, not status alone.
